description: Integrate The Odds API to fetch sporting events, betting lines, and scores. Enables auto-import of events and auto-grading of bets.

userStories.title: Create OddsAPIService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to communicate with The Odds API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create OddsAPIService.swift in Booki/Services/
Base URL: https://api.the-odds-api.com
Use @AppStorage for API key temporarily (will move to Keychain later)
Implement async request method with URLSession
Parse x-requests-remaining header to track quota
Handle errors: 401 (invalid key), 429 (rate limit), 500 (server error)
Create OddsAPIError enum for typed errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created OddsAPIService.swift with OddsAPIError enum, async request methods, quota header parsing

userStories.title: Create API Response Models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need models to decode The Odds API responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create OddsAPIModels.swift in Booki/Models/
OddsSport: key, group, title, description, active, hasOutrights
OddsEvent: id, sportKey, sportTitle, commenceTime, homeTeam, awayTeam, bookmakers
OddsBookmaker: key, title, lastUpdate, markets
OddsMarket: key, lastUpdate, outcomes
OddsOutcome: name, price, point (optional for spreads/totals)
OddsScore: id, sportKey, commenceTime, completed, homeTeam, awayTeam, scores
All models conform to Codable with proper CodingKeys for snake_case
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created OddsAPIModels.swift with all Codable models

userStories.title: Fetch Available Sports
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fetch the list of available sports from the API.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fetchSports() async throws -> [OddsSport] to OddsAPIService
Endpoint: GET /v4/sports/?apiKey={key}
Filter to only active sports (active == true)
This endpoint is free (doesn't count against quota)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fetch Events with Odds
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fetch upcoming events with betting odds.
acceptanceCriteria: Add fetchOdds(sport: String) async throws -> [OddsEvent] to OddsAPIService
Endpoint: GET /v4/sports/{sport}/odds/
Parameters: apiKey, regions=us, markets=h2h,spreads,totals, oddsFormat=american
Store preferred bookmaker in @AppStorage (default: draftkings)
Parse response into [OddsEvent] array
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added fetchOdds() method to OddsAPIService with all parameters

userStories.title: Add External ID Fields to Event Model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to track which events came from the API.
acceptanceCriteria: Add externalId: String? to Event model
Add externalSource: String? to Event model (e.g. 'the-odds-api')
Add lastOddsUpdate: Date? to Event model
Add homeScore: Int? to Event model
Add awayScore: Int? to Event model
Update Event initializer with new optional fields (default nil)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added externalId, externalSource, lastOddsUpdate, homeScore, awayScore to Event model. Supabase migration applied.

userStories.title: Create OddsAPIMapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to convert API responses to app models.
acceptanceCriteria: Create OddsAPIMapper.swift in Booki/Services/
Method: mapToEvent(from: OddsEvent, bookmaker: String) -> Event
Map commenceTime -> startTime, homeTeam/awayTeam directly
Map sportKey to sport and league (e.g. basketball_nba -> Basketball, NBA)
Set externalId to OddsEvent.id, externalSource to 'the-odds-api'
Method: mapToMarkets(from: OddsEvent, bookmaker: String, event: Event) -> [Market]
Convert h2h outcomes to moneyline Market with team names as sideA/sideB
Convert spreads outcomes to spread Market with point values in labels
Convert totals outcomes to total Market with Over/Under labels
Handle missing markets gracefully (return empty array)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created OddsAPIMapper.swift with mapToEvent and mapToMarkets methods

userStories.description: As a bookie, I want a button to import events from the API.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Import Events button to EventsListView toolbar
Show sheet with sport picker (populated from fetchSports)
Show Import button that fetches odds for selected sport
Show loading indicator during fetch

Save to SwiftData modelContext
Skip events that already exist (match by externalId)
Show success: 'Imported X events' or error alert

userStories.notes: Created ImportEventsView.swift with sport picker and import functionality

Filter to completed games (completed == true)

Parse score strings to integers
Set event.homeScore and event.awayScore
Set event.status to .completed
Save context
